title: SCA Minhag of the Week 206: “Reciting L’Shem Yihud Before a Missvah"

chapters.title: Origins of Leshem Yihud and Halab Customs
chapters.about: Arizal, Hida, tallit, tefillin, Omer, Aram Soba customs

chapters.title: Kabbalistic Reasons Not to Recite Leshem Yihud
chapters.about: Hakam Yitzhak Chehebar, unifying Hashem's name, Kabbalah requirements

chapters.title: Anecdote of Hakam Yosef Ades and Conclusion
chapters.about: Hakam Shelomo Alouf, Hakam Yosef Ades stopping the Hazan, Vihi No'am

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of reciting Leshem Yihud before prayers and misvot, tracing its origins to the Arizal and the Hida. He addresses whether this practice was followed in Halab, citing Hakam Yosef Abadi Shayyo, Hakam Yitzhak Chehebar, and a story told by Hakam Shelomo Alouf about Hakam Yosef Ades. He notes the reasons why some scholars refrained from reciting it and instead recited the verse Vihi No'am from Tehillim.
questions: What are the origins of reciting Leshem Yihud before prayers and misvot?
Was it customary in Halab to recite Leshem Yihud before a misva?
Why do some scholars advise against reciting Leshem Yihud?
What verse from Tehillim was customarily recited in Halab instead of Leshem Yihud?
